description: Header file defining the WebSocketStreamCreateTestBase class for testing WebSocket stream creation in Chromium's net/websockets module.

classes.name: WebSocketStreamCreateTestBase
classes.description: A test base class for creating and managing WebSocket streams, including connection handling and authentication.

methods.name: WebSocketStreamCreateTestBase
methods.description: Constructor for the test base class.

methods.name: CreateAndConnectStream
methods.description: Creates and connects a WebSocket stream with specified parameters.

methods.name: RequestHeadersToVector
methods.description: Converts HttpRequestHeaders to a vector of key-value pairs.

methods.name: ResponseHeadersToVector
methods.description: Converts HttpResponseHeaders to a vector of key-value pairs.

methods.name: failure_message
methods.description: Returns the failure message if connection failed.

methods.name: failure_response_code
methods.description: Returns the response code on failure.

methods.name: has_failed
methods.description: Indicates if the connection has failed.

methods.name: WaitUntilConnectDone
methods.description: Runs the connect run loop until connection is established or fails.

methods.name: WaitUntilOnAuthRequired
methods.description: Runs the auth required wait loop until OnAuthRequired is called.

methods.name: NoSubProtocols
methods.description: Returns an empty list of subprotocols for testing.
